description: This Java class defines a custom exception called GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a request contains an unresolved placeholder, providing builder methods for creating instances related to unknown placeholders and input with non-resolvable placeholders. The class extends DittoRuntimeException, includes static factory methods, and contains documentation comments for its API.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating unresolved placeholders in requests within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of GatewayPlaceholderNotResolvableException with customizable message, description, cause, and link.

methods.name: newUnknownPlaceholderBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for an exception when an unknown placeholder is encountered, including details about the unsupported placeholder and supported placeholders.

methods.name: newNotResolvableInputBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for an exception when input contains non-resolvable placeholders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, extracting error message information.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
